title: Build the anvil convert-batch milestone, slice 1
body:
Slice 1 of docs/plans/oracle/anvil-convert-batch.md: anvil --batch converts a stream, sharing one request path with single-shot, and decodes standard input with errors=replace so an undecodable byte refuses one line instead of ending the batch (R1004).

Code and tests were written by two workers in parallel from the same contract block, neither able to see the other. Assembly caught a real divergence — the tests imported from grimsverk_anvil.convert while the implementation had collapsed everything into cli.py — and it was resolved in favour of the plans module layout, with no edit to the blind tests. 43 tests pass; ruff and mypy clean.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
